command.label: ppp-sf-contradiction
command.request: Write and run a Python script (use the requests and csv libraries) that downloads South Dakota's public PPP loan data from the SBA FOIA open-data release at https://data.sba.gov/dataset/ppp-foia (there are state-level CSV files; South Dakota is small so the files are modest). Filter to rows whose borrower city is Sioux Falls (BorrowerCity contains 'SIOUX FALLS', case-insensitive). Write the matching rows to Documents\Aletheia\ppp_sioux_falls.csv with these columns: BorrowerName, BorrowerAddress, BorrowerCity, InitialApprovalAmount, JobsReported, NAICSCode, ForgivenessAmount. This is public FOIA data, read-only download; do not log in anywhere. IMPORTANT: at the very end, print to stdout exactly one JSON object and nothing else, like {"rows_written": 1234, "path": "C:\\Users\\caleb\\Documents\\Aletheia\\ppp_sioux_falls.csv", "source_urls": ["..."]}. If the download fails, still print one JSON object {"rows_written": 0, "error": "<short reason>"}.
